load_camera_extrinsics: load camera extrinsics from a text file and return a 4x4 numpy matrix
load_camera_intrinsics: load camera intrinsics from a text file and return focal length, principal point, and baseline
load_depth_map: load a SYNTHIA depth map PNG file and return a numpy array of depth values in centimeters
load_semantic_labels: load ground truth semantic segmentation labels from a PNG file with 16 class IDs
load_rgb_image: load a 1280x760 RGB image from a PNG file and return a uint8 numpy array
